notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Update Log
notes.content:
Added Game Instructions
The previous scene description letter has been replaced with UI-level rule instructions.
The game rules have been detailed to make it easier for first-time players to understand the game rules.

Added Crouching Function
When crouching, there will be no footsteps when moving.
But the movement speed will be very slow.

Added Ghost Indicator
The indicator can be used to know whether a ghost is nearby.

Other mechanism adjustments to reduce difficulty
- Added searchlight mechanism on the large map for quick positioning
- Modified the ghost's  tracking AI
- Some numerical changes
